claim_being_audited: The Actor’s recommendation to certify the model for launch as a reversible, monitored 5% rollout is compliant and sufficiently supported despite a known medical-device-support limitation in an exposed launch segment.
decision_criteria: Use operational-readiness evidence only for what it proves: aggregate pass, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, 5% rollout, rollback, and monitoring.
Apply the policy text as written: rollout controls mitigate only if the affected use case is excluded or reviewed risk acceptance explains why exposure is acceptable.
Treat the exposed below-target medical device support segment as a material unresolved predicate unless there is disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
Do not treat public governance guidance as a substitute for satisfying the enterprise policy condition.
evidence_requests: Approved risk acceptance explicitly covering medical device support exposure, with completed approver line.
Final model-card or launch disclosure showing the material limitation is disclosed for the named launch use case before launch.
Evidence that the initial rollout excludes the affected medical device support segment, if disclosure or approved risk acceptance is not available.
Formal launch decision record showing certification is allowed under policy despite the identified exposed weakness.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence supports aggregate readiness and rollout controls, but it also shows the affected medical device support segment remains exposed in the initial cohort.
The policy predicate for relying on rollout controls is not satisfied because the affected use case is not excluded and the available risk acceptance is not approved.
The policy requires disclosure of material limitations unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch; the record does not show completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
The Actor’s framing plausibly supports a narrow operational-readiness argument, but it does not close the compliance gap created by the exposed weak segment.
unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant on the present record, rather than only operationally defensible.
That rollout controls and reversibility sufficiently mitigate the model-card weakness while the affected segment remains exposed.
Any implication that disclosure or risk-acceptance requirements are already satisfied.
